evidence_scope: Repository author reports Radxa Cubie A7Z results. Not a T736 board validation. No files applied or software deployed.

readme.excerpt:
The Imagination driver on Linux 6.18 works well on the A733. \
After placing the firmware [here](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/imagination/linux-firmware/-/tree/powervr/powervr) in the correct location, the driver loads successfully. \
Building the Mesa driver from the main branch enables full functionality: `vulkaninfo` can detects the GPU, Wayland `sway` works with GLES, `vkmark` runs on-screen. \
Thanks to icenowy & iuncuim for assistance with debugging.

power_domain_patch.change: A733 GPU_CORE uses GENPD_FLAG_ALWAYS_ON; GPU_TOP is separate.

conclusion: This is an upstream PowerVR kernel plus matching Mesa stack alternative, not a ready-made port of Tina DDK 24.2. Do not combine upstream DRM UAPI with Tina proprietary userspace. Primary plan uses Tina DDK and GNOME GLES2/EGL first.
